idea-plugin.name: imux
idea-plugin.description:
imux manages your Claude Code, Codex, and pi sessions inside IntelliJ IDEA editor tabs.

Run AI coding sessions in editor tabs alongside your code. Tabs can be split, rearranged, or moved to another window without crowding the Terminal tool window.

The AI Agents tool window lists sessions for the current project by recent activity. Open any session with claude --resume, codex resume, or pi --session-id without looking up session IDs or terminal history.

imux notifies you when an agent finishes a turn or needs input. Notifications include the agent, elapsed time, and session title, and can take you directly to the latest output.

imux does not host or modify your sessions. It is a read-only view of each CLI's own session store. Uninstalling the plugin leaves all session history intact.

Features

  • Run sessions in editor tabs with split and multi-window support
  • Automatically show only sessions that belong to the current project
  • Distinct running, unread, and open states
  • IDE and system notifications for completed turns and input requests

Requirements: IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2+ and at least one supported CLI available in your terminal: claude, codex, or pi.
